name: dbsnp
description: dbSNP, NCBI's catalogue of short human variants, as its VCF for one genome build. Pinned to build 157 in dbSNP's archive, which is not replaced; a later build is a new address here.

GRCh38.size: about 30 GB, and as much again while it is being renamed
GRCh38.naming: Published with RefSeq accessions (NC_000001.11) and rewritten to this genome's own names through NCBI's assembly report for GRCh38.p14. Fits any GRCh38 genome, however it names its sequences. About 6% of its records are on patches and alternate loci that a primary assembly does not have; they keep their RefSeq names.

GRCh37.size: about 28 GB, and as much again while it is being renamed
GRCh37.naming: Published with RefSeq accessions (NC_000001.10) and rewritten to this genome's own names through NCBI's assembly report for GRCh37.p13.
